newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel steady, barge demand firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel steady, barge demand firm.

text.p: NWE jet fuel barge premiums were steady in firm demand on Thursday, traders said.
Jan IPE gas oil futures ended up 3.5 at $234 a tonne and Feb IPE ended $4.75 at $231 a tonne on cold European weather and forecasts of colder weather in the United States.

A barge traded at Feb IPE +$32/32.25, equivalent to Jan IPE +$28.25 fob ARA, slightly firmer. Traders saw no availability of jet fuel cargoes in northern Europe and predicted it would take up to two weeks for cargoes to arrive from the Med. Premiums in the Med were around fob Med high +$4/6.
